verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at public.missiveapp.com/v1. It has a complete endpoint reference covering analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels, with example requests, plus documented rate limits with 429 and Retry-After headers. Docs are LLM-friendly as Markdown pages and a docs/llms.txt index, and API access is listed on the pricing plans. missing for 10: an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (all probed paths 404), a formal versioning/deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Complete reference for Missive API endpoints: analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels, and more
Missive developer tools: REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, and custom channels for full customization.
Maximum of 5 concurrent requests at any given time; 300 requests per minute (equivalent to 5 requests per second)
